major_significance_stars.status: DECLINED WITH REASONS, argued in the PR
major_significance_stars.why: _destroyed_numeric_tokens decides whether to DISCARD the whole grid. Treating a dropped star as destruction rejects an entire table over one presentation mark, on a corpus where starred coefficients are the common case — trading a marker for a table, the cardinal rule inverted. The rowizer rebuild is not guaranteed to preserve the star either, so the rejection would not even fix it. Star loss deserves its own detector with its own remedy (flag the page, don't discard the grid) as a separate issue.
